authority.owner_continuation: This user-authorized direct Codex run uses only the public owner API. A future isolated Lilies assignment must use its task-scoped rendered contract.
authority.token_source: Use only the task-issued platform bearer. Never print or persist it.

budget.note: Direct deterministic Codex API work consumes no Lilies model tokens.

rules: Inspect the current revision before each Draft mutation.
Use one batch human pause, then resume with a decisions object.
Use integer cents and stable receipt or bank identities.
Only retry classified transient failures and keep attempts bounded.
A permission denial is terminal and cannot be reported as a business rejection.

program.block: Use the existing tool block with tool_name Program.
program.profile_discovery: Read the published profile; do not infer or expand its parameter, environment, network, timeout, or write scope.

input_contract.arguments: Exact argv suffix covered by one allowed prefix.
input_contract.stdin: JSON value or text sent to the official program.
input_contract.environment: Only published keys; use {$secret: name} for credentials.
input_contract.output_format: json or text, as allowed by the profile.
input_contract.idempotency_key: Required for every registered write prefix.

result_contract.ok: True only for zero exit and valid requested output.
result_contract.data: Parsed JSON or text from the official program.
result_contract.error_class: permission_denied, program_error, program_exit_nonzero, invalid_json_output, or null.
result_contract.receipt: Profile/version, request digest, exit status, write flag, and hashed idempotency key.

actual_official_contract.deduplication: transactions import invokes Actual rules/reconciliation and does not add the same imported_id twice; do not use addTransactions.
actual_official_contract.discovery: List remote budgets by name, download by Sync ID, then list accounts/categories/rules/transactions. Do not hardcode generated UUIDs.
